retro:
# Retrospective

Fresh verified Fable High and Astra Xhigh sessions independently reassessed public evidence and independently ran private PTY experiments. The most useful result beyond confirming fixes was correcting the original review's own blanket-option advice. Public defects and advisory corrections receive separate ledger entries.

Both reviewers noticed startup-dependent empty-line behavior. Explicit `--norc` and recorded library identity avoid assuming `--rcfile` excludes system bashrc. Astra's failed setup labels and negative control are preserved and qualified, not rewritten into an all-green run. Head test success is supported by inspected raw results and targeted failing diagnostics, not seals alone.

No isolation deviation or unsupported runtime fallback occurred. No desktop, audio, account, service or firewall resource was used. Temporary diagnostic copies were private; pinned sources remained unchanged. All runtime resources ended; idle native reviewer sessions and evidence remain for audit.

Process precision: Fable's introduction counted seven runs despite its eight-entry index. The synthesis records the correct eight plus Astra's three. No tool defect is inferred from this report-count typo. Source inspection and read-only evidence verification by the coordinator are distinct from reviewer execution.

Keep in future rounds: explicit startup provenance, testing proposed corrections as well as submitted fixes, and separate withdrawn advice from valid resolved defects. No Omadev issue was encountered because desktop resources were unnecessary. No browser or preview was opened; publication remains exclusively with the outer assistant.
comment:
**Verified:** Both findings in the [earlier review](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12837#issuecomment-5767993961) are resolved at `9589fadc374960f1e5edb012bd705926e7841411`: command paths regain filename insertion, and empty-word completion no longer emits `bad array subscript`. No new issue was found in the checked scope.

Actual post-Tab results with synthetic paths (`<SP>` denotes a trailing space):

```text
Input                 Previously reviewed head       Current head
./project             ./projects<SP>                  ./projects/
./space               ./space directory<SP>           ./space\ directory/
./projects/space      ./projects/space command<SP>    ./projects/space\ command<SP>
whitespace-only       bad array subscript             no array diagnostic
```

**Correction to the earlier suggestion:** The [author's counterexample](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12837#issuecomment-5768217168) is confirmed. The blanket `complete -I -o filenames -F ...` advice was too broad and is withdrawn: with executable `ls` on PATH and a directory named `ls` in the working directory, it inserts `ls/`. The current conditional `compopt` preserves `ls<SP>`, matching the pre-PR registration, while fixing path-shaped words.

**Condition clarified:** On Bash 5.3.15 with bash-completion 2.18.0 loaded, a completely empty line did not reach this completer. The old array diagnostic reproduced on whitespace-only prompts and empty words after command delimiters; without that library, it also reproduced on a completely empty line. The current guard fixes the reproduced cases.

**Verified:** Typed `omarchy-restart-s` still completes to `omarchy-restart-shell`; short-prefix and dispatcher completion remain intact. All eight current test checks pass. The added insertion check detects the old path regression, addressing the earlier test-coverage note.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Bash 5.3.15, repository inputrc, synthetic commands and paths in private interactive shells, with and without bash-completion 2.18.0. No other Bash versions or full desktop/startup integration tested.

**Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Automated AI review:** Fresh independent Fable 5.1 High and Astra Xhigh follow-up reviews and isolated experiments, followed by Astra coordinator source inspection, evidence verification and adjudication.
